payload.reason: The evidence indicates that ARAML significantly improves the stability and performance of text generation models compared to traditional GANs.

claims.text: ARAML outperforms state-of-the-art text GANs with a more stable training process.
Experiments show that ARAML performs significantly better than other baselines in all cases, indicating enhanced performance.
The incorporation of RAML into the adversarial training paradigm results in lower training variance and better performance on text generation tasks.
